title: Smoked Lamb Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful North African-inspired lamb tagine made with smoked lamb, wild onions, and a blend of spices.
instructions: 2. Cut the smoked lamb into 1-inch cubes and season with salt and black pepper.
3. Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven or clay tagine over medium heat.
4. Sear the lamb cubes until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from the pot and set aside.
5. Add more oil if necessary and sauté the wild onions until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
6. Add the tagine spice blend and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
7. Add the lamb broth to the pot and bring to a simmer.
8. Return the lamb cubes to the pot, cover, and transfer to the preheated oven.
9. Braise the lamb for 2-1/2 to 3 hours, or until tender and falling apart.
10. Garnish with chopped fresh parsley, if desired. Serve hot.
